title: Evaluating Feedback-Driven Black-Box Processes via Stochastic Modeling and Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study feedback-driven black-box processes across software engineering and machine learning. These processes are inherently sequential: policies generate inputs, observe outputs/feedback from systems, and use the feedback to guide the design of subsequent inputs. While many policies are developed under structural assumptions on the underlying systems, many real-world systems operate without such knowledge, necessitating black-box policies that lack a unified evaluation framework. We introduce a stochastic framework that models and evaluates such policies using Markov chains and simulation, thereby connecting empirical practice with theory. We instantiate the framework in mutation-based fuzzing (widely used for discovering software bugs via sequential input mutation), by a novel Markov chain model of fuzzing whose transitions are governed by the mutation strategy and whose feedback is given by program execution. translated_title: 基于随机建模与仿真评估反馈驱动的黑盒过程
translated_abstract: 我们研究软件工程与机器学习领域中反馈驱动的黑盒过程。这些过程本质上是顺序进行的：策略生成输入、观察系统的输出/反馈，并利用反馈来指导后续输入的设计。虽然许多策略是在对底层系统做出结构假设的前提下开发的，但许多现实世界的系统在缺乏此类知识的情况下运行，因此需要黑盒策略，而这类策略目前缺乏统一的评估框架。我们引入了一个随机框架，利用马尔可夫链和仿真来建模与评估此类策略，从而将实证实践与理论联系起来。我们通过一种新颖的模糊测试马尔可夫链模型，将该框架实例化于基于变异的模糊测试（一种广泛用于通过顺序输入变异发现软件缺陷的技术）中，该模型的转移由变异策略控制，其反馈由程序执行给出。我们开发了一个严格的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于马尔可夫链和仿真的随机建模框架，用于统一评估反馈驱动的黑盒过程，并通过新颖的模糊测试马尔可夫链模型加以实例化，从而将实证实践与理论联系起来。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a stochastic framework based on Markov chains and simulation for uniformly modeling and evaluating feedback-driven black-box processes, instantiated through a novel Markov chain model of fuzzing, thereby connecting empirical practice with theory.
